name: Bánh giò
summary: A small pyramid cake sold beside the Da Lat xíu mại bowls.
origin: Visit Lâm Đồng’s food-tour note lists bánh giò as a cake to add to a bánh mì xíu mại breakfast.
howToEat: Order it with the xíu mại bowl. A filling list was not printed.
where: The xíu mại counters the food-tour note names, 26 Hoàng Diệu and 26 Phạm Nhật Duật. Hours are Check on arrival.
priceBand: The food-tour note prints 6,000 VND a cake.
